pages.title: Parks team handbook
pages.body: Home page for how the parks team works: events, trees, playgrounds, bins, the cemetery and contractors.

pages.title: Booking an event in a park
pages.body: Organisers apply at least eight weeks ahead with a site plan, insurance and a risk assessment. The events officer checks clashes with other bookings and grounds work.

pages.title: Tree enquiries
pages.body: Every tree enquiry gets a visit within ten working days. Urgent hazards, such as a hanging branch over a path, are made safe the same day by the duty crew.

pages.title: Playground inspection routine
pages.body: Weekly visual checks by the grounds team, quarterly operational checks by the supervisor, and an annual independent inspection.

pages.title: Litter bins and dog waste bins
pages.body: Bins in the market square are emptied daily; park bins three times a week. Report damaged bins to Downland Waste Services through the contract portal.

pages.title: Memorial benches
pages.body: Families can sponsor a bench for ten years. Locations are agreed with bereavement services and the plaque wording is approved before ordering.

pages.title: Volunteers in the parks
pages.body: Volunteers sign in with the coordinator, are given gloves and pickers, and never use powered tools.

pages.title: Grounds maintenance contract
pages.body: Wexcombe Grounds Maintenance cut the grass and hedges to the agreed frequencies and send a monthly report with photos.
